capabilities.title: One system covers your entire overseas business.
capabilities.desc: Not six independent island tools, but a deeply collaborative, data-interconnected enterprise overseas business growth system.

01.label: 01 / Precision Lead Engine
01.title: Continuously find high-intent customers who may actually buy from you.
01.desc: Not just mechanically scraping contact info in the open ocean, but deeply scanning global customs import/export data, corporate financial reports, social media recruitment trends, and technology updates to precisely capture real buyers currently seeking suppliers.

02.label: 02 / Intelligent Audience Scoring
02.title: Not finding more customers, but finding customers worth following up with.
02.desc: AI comprehensively calculates Lead Score based on enterprise scale, product match, historical purchase frequency, decision chain authority, and cash flow health. Let the sales team focus 100% of their energy on the top 20% of high-value transactions.

03.label: 03 / Global Social Media Matrix Operations
03.title: Keep your brand consistently in front of your target customers.
03.desc: Say goodbye to mechanically cheap AI filler content. The system combines local industrial hotspots and industry trends, automatically adapting to LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Meta communication norms to form continuous brand assets with professional technical persuasion.

04.label: 04 / Customer Lifecycle Maintenance
04.title: Closing the deal is not the end, but the beginning of the customer lifecycle.
04.desc: Real-time monitoring of old customer procurement cycles, unboxing feedback, and seasonal replenishment patterns. When customer purchase frequency drops abnormally or churn signs appear, automatically dispatch customized follow-up strategies to account managers.

05.label: 05 / International Situation & Global Market Intelligence
05.title: What's happening in the world, AI tells you its direct relationship to business.
05.desc: Not just scraping general news. The system monitors tariffs, exchange rates, geopolitical policies, raw material commodity prices, and shipping capacity indices 24/7. The core is: telling you what to do.
05.monitor: Monitoring scope: International trade policy • Tariff changes • Exchange rate fluctuations • Shipping container indices • Supply chain changes

06.label: 06 / Full-process Fulfillment & Risk Early Warning
06.title: From the first inquiry, track all the way to safe order delivery.
06.desc: Connect factory production scheduling, port logistics waybills, and foreign exchange settlement. Automatically identify production delays, payment credit anomalies, and customs clearance bottlenecks to prevent delivery defaults and exchange rate collection losses.

agent.title: You are responsible for business decisions. AI is responsible for 24/7 execution.
agent.desc: This is not a chat box where you repeatedly input prompts. AI Agents, based on preset global growth strategies, autonomously search, screen, communicate, and schedule. Business personnel only need to confirm at key nodes.
agent.benefit1: No training: No need to learn complex model instructions and tool chains
